customer.target: Owners of trade and home-service businesses (solo to 10 employees) in Montréal, Laval and surrounding areas who miss calls while working on job sites or serving customers

behaviours.name: Uses scheduling or CRM software

pitch:
TradeCatch answers your business line 24/7, in Québec French and English, under your company name. It asks the caller's name, number, address, what they need and how urgent it is, texts you right away, and follows up with the caller by text. A quote that goes quiet gets a text follow-up on day 1, 3, 7 and 14, which stops when the customer replies or you take over.

Urgent calls: the receptionist tells the caller it is connecting them and rings your phone. The call is connected only when you press 1. If you are busy or do not pick up, it stays with the caller, takes the details, and texts you. It never transfers to 911.

Essential: 1,999.99 $ setup, paid once, then 249 $ a month. Professional: same setup, then 349 $ a month, and it also books appointments into your Google Calendar with text confirmations and reminders. Month to month after setup, cancel with notice. All prices CAD.

Before you pay anything, in the free demo the founder goes through your recent call log with you and counts the calls you missed. If there are too few for this to pay, he tells you and does not install it. Before go-live you hear recorded test calls in French and English, including a stressed no-heat caller at night. Nothing speaks or sends until you approve the wording.

60-day guarantee: if 60 days after go-live it has not captured at least 10 caller requests that you did not pick up, the 1,999.99 $ setup fee is refunded.

The founder sets it up with you: he maps how calls and quotes move through your business, writes every message with you, tests every scenario with your team before it goes live, and keeps watching it after. He can do 5 installs at a time, so the first 5 in plumbing and HVAC in Laval and Montréal are open until 2027-01-31 or until they are filled. Founding clients give a reference call and their before and after call counts once live.

Each plan includes a monthly allowance of call minutes and text messages; extra usage is billed only if you confirm it. It does not book into CRM tools such as Jobber; it books into Google Calendar.

Your existing business number stays: it still rings you first, and if nobody picks up or the call comes after hours, the receptionist answers.

Free demo: you talk with the founder, and you can call the live demo line now from the website.

(When asked for prices, answer in Canadian dollars per month.)
